nodes.label:
Grant Opportunity
Identified
nodes.title: Grant Opportunity Identified
nodes.info: A foundation, company, or government program with funding priorities that plausibly match the club's mission.

nodes.label:
Match Club Facts to
Funder's Language
nodes.title: Match Club Facts to Funder's Language
nodes.info: Rewrite the club's real activities using the funder's own stated priority terms. Not inventing new activities -- describing the existing ones in the words the reader is scanning for.

nodes.label:
Draft Using Standard
Proposal Structure
nodes.title: Draft Using Standard Proposal Structure
nodes.info: Needs statement, project description, budget, evaluation plan, organisational background.

nodes.label:
Submit Before
Deadline
nodes.title: Submit Before Deadline
nodes.info: Log the submission immediately in the tracking spreadsheet with status 'Submitted'. Logging it later means not logging it.

nodes.label:
Funder
Response?
nodes.title: Funder Response?
nodes.info: Most funders reply within 4 to 12 weeks. If no reply by the funder's stated window, a tracked follow-up email is due.

nodes.label:
Log Award and Any
Report Deadlines
nodes.title: Log Award and Any Report Deadlines
nodes.info: Update status to 'Awarded' and add every required report deadline as its own tracked row, not just the grant deadline itself. A missed report is how a club loses a renewal.

nodes.label:
Log Outcome and
Request Feedback
nodes.title: Log Outcome and Request Feedback
nodes.info: Update status to 'Declined'. Many funders will share brief feedback on request, which is the most useful thing a declined application produces.

nodes.label:
Update Tracking
Spreadsheet
nodes.title: Update Tracking Spreadsheet
nodes.info: Every branch above ends here. The tracking step is what prevents a missed report or a forgotten reapplication next cycle.
